readme.text:
[English](README.en.md) | 中文

给 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件列表里的插件自定义中文备注名，直接显示在原生插件设置页；支持按备注/标签分组、分组折叠、官方插件保护与自定义标签。

- 自动把插件列表里的英文包名替换成自定义中文备注，悬停显示原来的英文包名
- 可视化编辑面板：左下角「📝 备注」按钮，或按 `Ctrl+Shift+N` 打开
- 自动扫描当前已安装的所有插件，直接编辑备注；备注保存在浏览器 localStorage 里，永久生效
- 🛡 官方插件默认不可改名：`@deepseek-ai/*` 与 dsh 内置 bundle 标「官方」且输入框禁用；面板「高级」可开「改官方」开关放开限制
- 🗂 分组显示：可按「是否有备注」或「按标签」分组，分组标题可点击折叠/展开，状态记忆
- 🏷 自定义标签：条目内「+ 标签」新建并打标，可切换/删除；固定分类「官方 / 已修改 / 未修改」自动打标
- 🔍 搜索框、按原名/备注名排序、导出/导入备份、按钮拖动、总开关、一键重置

readme.section: 方式一：GitHub 仓库直接安装（推荐）
readme.text:
桌面端（DSH 0.2.0-rc.2）：在侧栏打开「插件 → 添加插件」，粘贴下面的地址，安装后选择「立即启用」。若应用提示需要重启，按提示操作。

```
github:sanlisanxun/dsh-plugin-nickname
```

1. 下载本项目，解压到本地文件夹
2. 打开 dsh → 插件 → 添加插件
3. 输入本地文件夹的完整路径，点安装
4. 刷新页面生效

安装后：
- 点左下角的「📝 备注」按钮，或按 `Ctrl+Shift+N` 打开编辑面板
- 在输入框里直接改中文名字，按 Tab 键保存
- 留空则恢复原来的英文包名

```
dsh-plugin-nickname/
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js      # Host 端插件入口
│   └── client.js     # 客户端脚本（注入到浏览器页面）
- 🏷 新增分组标签：面板「按…分组」新增「按标签分组」（与「按是否有备注分组」并存）；固定分类「官方 / 已修改 / 未修改」自动打标；用户可自建自定义标签并在条目内点选打标，「高级」区可管理/删除
- 🗂 分组可折叠：分组显示时点击分组标题可展开/收起，折叠状态持久化，标题左侧指示符 `▾` 展开 / `▸` 收起

- 🛡 官方插件默认不可改名：`@deepseek-ai/*` 与 dsh 内置 bundle 不再被替换，面板里标「官方」且输入框禁用
- ✨ 新增「改官方」开关：需要时勾上即可解除屏蔽
- ✨ 保存备注前增加官方插件拦截，绕过界面也写不进去

- 🐛 修复真实浏览器下备注不生效：替换守卫用 `childNodes.length <= 2` 计数，换行空白文本节点会让它变成 3 而被挡掉；改为只按元素子节点计数，与渲染方式无关
- 🐛 修复插件改写自己界面：编辑面板里的包名标签会被自己的替换逻辑覆盖，导致标签显示成备注名；现在跳过所有 `[data-nickname-ui]` 内部节点
- ✅ 新增真实浏览器验证 `npm run test:browser`（Chromium 加载 `tests/harness/index.html`，7 条断言）

- 🐛 修复备注完全不生效：dsh 的插件名在 `<button class="cardTitle">` 里，外层还有两层 `div`；「只改写文本节点」后容器里没有直接文本节点，替换被整体跳过。现改为向下定位真正承载文本的叶子节点再写入
- 🐛 修复标题按钮被抹掉：旧版用 `textContent` 覆盖容器会连 `<button>`、图标、描述一起清空，列表项点不开
- ✨ 支持 dsh「显示名 (包名)」标题形式，如 `dsh-context` 的 `上下文 (dsh-context)`
- ✨ 默认扫描选择器补上 `button`
- ⚡ 面板列表改以 dsh 卡片上的 `data-plugin-package` 为准收集已安装插件，不再只靠文本猜测

- ✨ 支持无 `__ModuleLoader__` 的宿主环境（dsh web 版）：检测不到模块加载器时自行启动
- ✨ 存储读写增加内存兜底：localStorage 不可用（隐私模式 / web 版）时不再中断
- ⚡ 取消固定等待 1 秒：改为立即初始化 + 最多约 2 秒重试，按钮与备注即时生效
- ✨ 面板「高级」新增扫描选择器与包名正则配置，dsh 改版导致 DOM 结构变化时无需改代码
- 🐛 dispose 改为按会话标记多轮清扫（0 / 200 / 600ms），清掉宿主在 dispose 之后补渲染的残留
- ✨ 检测不到插件列表时给出「点此刷新页面」提示，面板新增「刷新页面使改动生效」按钮

- 🐛 修复替换插件名时误伤子元素：改为只改写直接文本节点，不再用 `textContent` 覆盖整个卡片
- 🐛 修复包名前缀冲突：`dsh.plugin` 与 `dsh.plugin-manager` 这类存在包含关系时，改为长包名优先
- 🐛 修复备注名含引号/尖括号时破坏面板结构：包名与备注在渲染前做 HTML 转义
- 🐛 修复重置或导入备注后面板被关闭：修正 `openEditPanel` 的开关语义
- 🐛 修复反复开关面板在 `<head>` 累积 `<style>` 标签，关闭时同步移除样式与外部点击监听
- 🐛 完善 dispose：补充清理 MutationObserver 防抖定时器与 `window.__setPluginNickname` 等全局挂载
- 🐛 修复导出 JSON 时 URL 回收过快可能中断下载
- ⚡ 优化 MutationObserver：防抖定时器收进闭包，扫描后丢弃自身写入触发的变更记录

- 🐛 修复编辑面板样式注入变量未声明（`style` → `styleEl`）：严格模式下不再抛 `ReferenceError`，面板可正常打开
- 🐛 修复 dispose 时样式标签无法移除导致的残留
- ✨ 新增卸载插件按钮：一键清除所有本地数据，并提示在 dsh 插件列表完成卸载
- 🐛 修复关闭插件后 UI 残留，完善 dispose 清理逻辑

- ✨ 新增排序功能：支持按原名/备注名排序
- ✨ 新增分组功能：按是否有备注分组显示
- ✨ 优化 UI 样式：更美观的深色主题设计

- 🎨 优化 UI 样式，和 dsh 深色主题更匹配
- 按钮加了悬停效果和动画

- ✨ 新增总开关：一键启用/禁用所有备注替换
- ✨ 新增重置按钮：一键清除所有自定义备注
- ✨ 新增按钮拖动：左下角的备注按钮可以拖到任意位置
- ✨ 按钮位置自动保存，刷新后位置不变

- 🐛 修复 bug：关闭插件后遗留按钮的问题
- 卸载插件时自动清理所有 DOM 元素和事件监听

- ✨ 新增搜索框：插件多的时候快速查找
- ✨ 新增导出/导入功能：备份你的备注设置
- ✨ 优化交互：点击面板外面自动关闭

- 🎉 首次发布
- 支持自定义插件中文备注名
- 支持可视化编辑面板
- 支持快捷键 Ctrl+Shift+N 打开面板

Custom Chinese nicknames for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugins, displayed directly in the native plugin settings page. Supports grouping (by nickname / by tag), collapsible groups, official-plugin protection, and custom tags.

- Automatically replace English package names in the plugin list with custom Chinese nicknames; hover to see the original English name
- Visual edit panel: click the "📝 Nickname" button in the bottom left, or press `Ctrl+Shift+N`
- Automatically scan all installed plugins for direct editing; nicknames are saved in browser localStorage and persist
- 🛡 Official plugins are protected by default: `@deepseek-ai/*` and dsh's built-in bundles are marked "官方" with a disabled input; an "改官方" (allow official) toggle in Advanced lifts the restriction
- 🗂 Grouping: group by whether a nickname is set, or by tag; group headers collapse/expand and remember their state
- 🏷 Custom tags: create and apply a tag inline via "+ 标签"; toggle or delete tags; fixed categories "官方 / 已修改 / 未修改" are applied automatically
- 🔍 Search box, sort by original/nickname name, export/import, draggable button, master switch, one-click reset

Desktop (DSH 0.2.0-rc.2): Open "Plugins → Add Plugin" in the sidebar, paste the address below, and select "Enable Now" after installation. If prompted to restart, follow the instructions.

```
github:sanlisanxun/dsh-plugin-nickname
```

1. Download this project and extract it to a local folder
2. Open dsh → Plugins → Add Plugin
3. Enter the full path to the local folder and click install
4. Refresh the page to take effect

After installation:
- Click the "📝 Nickname" button in the bottom left, or press `Ctrl+Shift+N` to open the edit panel
- Edit Chinese names directly in the input box, press Tab to save
- Leave blank to restore the original English package name

```
dsh-plugin-nickname/
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js      # Host-side plugin entry
│   └── client.js     # Client-side script (injected into the browser page)

- 🏷 Added tag grouping: a new "by tag" grouping option (alongside "by nickname"); fixed categories "官方 / 已修改 / 未修改" are applied automatically; users can create custom tags and apply them inline, and manage/delete them in Advanced
- 🗂 Collapsible groups: when grouping is on, click a group header to expand/collapse; the state persists, with a `▾` / `▸` indicator

- 🛡 Official plugins can no longer be renamed by default: `@deepseek-ai/*` and dsh's built-in bundles are skipped, marked “官方” and disabled in the panel
- ✨ New “改官方” (allow official) toggle to lift the restriction when you need it
- ✨ Saving a nickname for an official plugin is blocked even if the UI is bypassed

- 🐛 Fixed nicknames not applying in a real browser: the guard counted `childNodes.length <= 2`, so whitespace text nodes from line breaks pushed it to 3 and blocked the replacement; it now counts element children only
- 🐛 Fixed the plugin rewriting its own panel: the package-name labels inside the edit panel were being replaced with the nicknames; nodes inside `[data-nickname-ui]` are now skipped
- ✅ Added real-browser verification: `npm run test:browser` (Chromium loads `tests/harness/index.html`, 7 assertions)

- 🐛 Fixed nicknames not applying at all: dsh renders the plugin name inside `<button class="cardTitle">` wrapped in two more `div`s, so the leaf-only rewrite found no direct text node and skipped everything. It now walks down to the node that actually holds the text
- 🐛 Fixed the title button being wiped out: the old `textContent` overwrite also cleared the `<button>`, icon and description
- ✨ Supports dsh's `Display Name (package)` title form, e.g. `上下文 (dsh-context)`
- ✨ `button` added to the default scan selector
- ⚡ The panel list now derives installed packages from dsh's `data-plugin-package` attribute instead of guessing from text

- ✨ Works without `__ModuleLoader__` (dsh web): self-boots when no module loader is present
- ✨ Storage falls back to memory when localStorage is unavailable (private mode / web)
- ⚡ Removed the fixed 1 s delay: initializes immediately, then retries for up to ~2 s
- ✨ Advanced settings in the panel: scan selector and package-name regex are configurable
- 🐛 dispose now sweeps UI by session tag at 0 / 200 / 600 ms, removing late-rendered leftovers
- ✨ Shows a "click to reload" hint when no plugin list is detected; panel has a reload button

- 🐛 Fixed nickname replacement wiping child elements: only direct text nodes are rewritten now
- 🐛 Fixed package-name prefix collision (`dsh.plugin` vs `dsh.plugin-manager`): longest name wins
- 🐛 Fixed panel markup being broken by quotes/angle brackets in nicknames: HTML-escaped before render
- 🐛 Fixed the panel being closed after reset/import: corrected the open/close semantics
- 🐛 Fixed `<style>` tags accumulating in `<head>` when toggling the panel repeatedly
- 🐛 Hardened dispose: clears the MutationObserver debounce timer and global handles
- 🐛 Fixed the export URL being revoked too early, which could abort the download
- ⚡ Optimized MutationObserver: debounce timer moved into the closure; self-triggered records discarded

- 🐛 Fixed undeclared variable (`style` → `styleEl`) when injecting panel styles: no more `ReferenceError` in strict mode, the panel opens correctly
- 🐛 Fixed the injected `<style>` tag not being removable on dispose
- ✨ Added uninstall button: clears all local data and prompts you to finish uninstalling in the dsh plugin list
- 🐛 Fixed leftover UI after disabling the plugin; improved dispose cleanup

- ✨ Added sorting by original name / nickname
- ✨ Added grouping by whether a nickname is set
- 🎨 Improved UI for the dark theme

- 🎨 Refined UI styles to better match the dsh dark theme
- Added hover effect and animation to the floating button

- ✨ Added master switch for enabling/disabling nickname replacement
- ✨ Added reset button to clear all custom nicknames
- ✨ Added draggable floating button with auto-saved position

- ✨ Added search box: quickly find plugins when there are many
- ✨ Added export/import: backup your nickname settings
- ✨ Improved interaction: click outside the panel to auto-close

- 🎉 First release
- Support custom plugin Chinese nicknames
- Support visual edit panel
- Support shortcut Ctrl+Shift+N to open panel
